# Test fixtures

Small inputs for the ingester tests, so `pytest` runs on a fresh clone with nothing under
`data/`. Most are short excerpts of the real sources, cut down to the rows a test needs. A file
called `*_subset.json`, `*_excerpt*` or `gns_names.json` comes from a file the pipeline writes
under `data/work/` (named in the file's own `_about` or `note` field). That file is derived from
the sources named below and carries their licences.

Each source keeps its own licence. The repository's Apache-2.0 licence covers the code, not
these excerpts.

| Folder | Files | Where they came from | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caccf/` | `CAC.DEC98.excerpt` | 8 fixed-width records from the NARA Combat Area Casualties Current File, Dec 1998 extract (`CAC.DEC98.CURRENT`, RG 330, NAID 1965870). The service-number field (positions 44-52) is replaced by synthetic digits of the same shape, because some real values are Social Security numbers. | US federal record, public domain |
| | `hes_provinces.json` | Trimmed copy of `data/work/hes_provinces.json`: every GVN province's names, region, centroid and covering radius, built from the NARA HES gazetteers (the radii also use NGA GNS places) | Public domain (NARA, NGA) |
| `datum_check/` | `pairs.json` | Three HES hamlets (NARA RG 472 HES gazetteers) and the GNS populated places (NGA) that share their names | Public domain (NARA, NGA) |
| `gns/` | `vietnam_excerpt.txt` | 17 rows of the NGA GEOnet Names Server Vietnam country file (`Vietnam.txt`, pinned Wayback capture of 2026-09-03) | US Government work, public domain (NGA) |
| `hes_gazetteer/` | `RG349.NPIASS.GZSF.txt`, `RG349.NPIASS.HVGZ.txt`, `RG349.NPIASS.HGAZ` | A few fixed-width records from each of the NARA RG 472 NPIASS Hamlet Evaluation System gazetteers | US federal records, public domain |
| | `gns_subset.json` | Excerpt of `data/work/gns_index.json` (the NGA GNS name index) | Public domain (NGA) |
| `library/` | `map_library.json` | A four-map catalogue in the shape of `data/sources/map_library.json`, pointing at a fake archive the tests run locally. The map files it serves are generated by the tests. | Written for this repository (Apache-2.0) |
| `vhpa/` | `*.HTM` | Synthetic pages written for the tests in the layout of the VHPA helicopter-loss database. No real record is copied. | Written for this repository (Apache-2.0) |
| | `gns_places_excerpt.json` | Thinned excerpt of `data/work/gns_index.json` (the NGA GNS name index): one place per 0.05-degree cell, positions only, for the "is this loss in Vietnam" checks. The same tests read `wikidata_osm/vn_boundary.json` for the national boundary | Public domain (NGA) |
| `vn_relics/` | `main_excerpt.wikitext`, `special_excerpt.wikitext` | Wikitext excerpts of the vi.wikipedia pages "Danh sách Di tích quốc gia Việt Nam" and "Di tích quốc gia đặc biệt (Việt Nam)" | Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| | `coords_api.json` | A vi.wikipedia API `prop=coordinates` answer, trimmed to the pages the tests use | Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| | `wdqs_district_communes.json` | A Wikidata Query Service answer (district -> commune members), trimmed to a few districts | Wikidata, CC0 |
| | `osm_province_borders.json` | An Overpass API answer with OpenStreetMap province boundary relations | © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 |
| | `gns_index_excerpt.json` | Excerpt of `data/work/gns_index.json` (the NGA GNS name index) | Public domain (NGA) |
| `wiki_mia/` | `excerpt_1966-68.wikitext`, `excerpt_named_places.wikitext` | Table rows from the en.wikipedia "List of United States servicemembers and civilians missing in action during the Vietnam War" period pages | Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| | `gns_subset.json` | Excerpt of `data/work/gns_index.json` (the NGA GNS name index) | Public domain (NGA) |
| | `provinces_subset.json` | Subset of `data/work/hes_provinces.json` (from the NARA HES gazetteers) | Public domain (NARA, NGA) |
| `wikidata_osm/` | `wd_match.json`, `wd_detail.json`, `wd_locations.json`, `wd_statements.json` | Wikidata Query Service answers, trimmed to the items the tests use | Wikidata, CC0 |
| | `osm_elements.json`, `osm_areas_geom.json` | Overpass API answers, trimmed to a few OpenStreetMap elements | © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 |
| | `vn_boundary.json` | OpenStreetMap relation 49915 (Vietnam), member ways cut to every 10th vertex | © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 |
| | `gns_names.json` | Excerpt of `data/work/gns_index.json` (the NGA GNS name index) | Public domain (NGA) |
